# process_daily { #wass2s.process_daily }

```python
process_daily(
    dir_save,
    var_key,
    target_date_str,
    n_days=30,
    stat=None,
    clim_start=None,
    clim_end=None,
    precip_source='era5',
    agera5_version='2_0',
)
```

Download, aggregate, and plot the last *n_days* up to the target date.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default    |
|-----------------|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| dir_save        | str                         | Root directory for cached NetCDF files.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | _required_ |
| var_key         | str                         | Variable key defined in :data:`VAR_CONFIG`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
| target_date_str | str                         | ISO-format target date (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``); last day of the window.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | _required_ |
| n_days          | int                         | Length of the window in days.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `30`       |
| stat            | (mean, sum, ratio, anomaly) | Aggregation over the window.  Defaults to ``"sum"`` for precipitation and ``"mean"`` for every other variable.  - ``"ratio"`` — window total as a percentage of the climatological   normal for the same calendar window (precip-oriented). - ``"anomaly"`` — window mean minus the climatological window-mean   normal, on a diverging scale (SST/T2m/SLP-oriented; scalar fields   only, not the wind/streamline variables).  ``"ratio"`` and ``"anomaly"`` both require *clim_start*/*clim_end*. | `"mean"`   |
| clim_start      | int                         | Inclusive reference-period bounds.  Required for ``"ratio"``/``"anomaly"``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`     |
| clim_end        | int                         | Inclusive reference-period bounds.  Required for ``"ratio"``/``"anomaly"``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                       | Description                                                        |
|--------|--------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.DataArray or xarray.Dataset or None | The aggregated field (ratio %, anomaly, sum or mean), or ``None``. |
